items.title: Natural Gas Cash Prices Split as Record Heat Lifts West, Appalachia Slides
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices were mixed Monday as record-breaking heat across the southern tier lifted Gulf Coast and Western hubs, while Appalachia sank to levels that could trigger Marcellus Shale supply curtailments this fall.

items.title: Texas Bakes, but Natural Gas Futures Rally Fizzles as Storage Cushion Weighs
items.summary: Natural gas futures squeezed out a small gain Monday as sweltering Texas heat and a dip in production provided just enough support to keep bulls afloat after an overnight rally lost steam.

items.title: Gas Storage Build Likely to Grow, but Falling Rig and Frac Counts Raise Supply Questions
items.summary: NGI is projecting the latest US Energy Information Administration (EIA) weekly natural gas storage report for the week ended Aug. 21 will show an injection of 23 Bcf, 7 Bcf higher week/week and 6 Bcf more than the 17 Bcf injection from last year.

items.title: Powerful El Niño Reshapes Natural Gas Weather Risks Ahead of Winter

items.title: Equinor Extends Europe Natural Gas Supply as Norway Targets Bigger Finds
items.summary: Equinor is locking in more long-term natural gas supply agreements with Europe’s critical energy hubs as it gathers partners to increase volumes and the lifespan of Norway’s offshore assets.

items.title: Canada Eyes LNG, Natural Gas Expansion as US Trade War Escalates
items.summary: Trade tensions between key natural gas allies the United States and Canada are spiraling after a breakdown in talks over the past few days.

items.title: TTF, JKM Charge Higher as Tight Supplies Drive Competition for Cargoes
items.summary: Asian and European natural gas prices continued their rally Monday as global supplies faced competing threats.

items.title: Early Gains Fade as Heat, Lower Production Support Natural Gas
items.summary: Natural gas futures pared most of their early gains late Monday morning as ample inventories and easing power-sector demand tempered support from persistent heat and lower production.

items.title: Searing Western Temperatures Support Weekly Natural Gas Spot Prices

items.title: Does the 5-Year Natural Gas Inventory Average Still Matter?
items.summary: US natural gas storage levels sit at a comfortable 6.2% surplus to the five-year average, but they have struggled to shake a deficit versus a year ago, which some analysts say is the more relevant comparison.
